subtitle: Kredit tanpa jaminan. Bayar tepat waktu dan naikkan limit Anda.
howItWorksBody: Request credit, repay on schedule, and participate in the results of your network.

notificationLead: Aplikasi mengirim dua pemberitahuan pembayaran per angsuran: di titik tengah dan sebelum batas. Pemberitahuan itu selalu aktif. WhatsApp, Telegram, komisi, dan pendaftaran baru bersifat opsional.
notificationDebtAlways: Di pertengahan jangka dan sebelum batas. Tanpa pengingat harian.
notificationInvalidPhone: Masukkan nomor dengan kode negara, misalnya +58412…
notificationTelegramHint: Setel EXPO_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_BOT dan jalankan layanan notifikasi untuk menyelesaikan tautan.
debtReminderMid: Anda di titik tengah angsuran ini. Anda bisa bayar sekarang, bukan menunggu batas.
debtReminderCutoff: Pembayaran segera jatuh tempo. Lunasi sebelum batas agar tidak menunggak.
rankFrameHint: Bingkai di sekitar foto Anda adalah spanduk peringkat. Master adalah yang tertinggi.
sectionAccountLead: Ini akun pribadi Anda. Kredit serta stablecoin atau BNB yang Anda terima adalah milik Anda. Pool likuiditas adalah kotak terpisah: tinggal di kontrak dan tidak dicampur dengan saldo ini.
sectionCreditLineLead: Pinjaman diajukan dan dilunasi hanya dari akun ini. MetaMask dan yang lain untuk memindahkan dana masuk atau keluar.
sectionLoansLead: Setiap level yang terbuka tetap tersedia. Level yang belum tercapai tampak abu-abu. Level 10 adalah maksimum saat ini dan masih memakai masa tunggu antar pinjaman.
sectionInviteLead: Bagikan tautan Anda. Orang baru bisa meminjam, dan jika mereka mengundang, mereka mendapat ketika orang mereka meminjam dan membayar. Akun tunggakan tidak bisa mengundang atau mendapat.
sectionAlertsLead: Aplikasi selalu mengingatkan di pertengahan jangka dan sebelum batas. Saluran lain opsional.
walletVsPoolHint: Ini hanya saldo akun Anda. Pool likuiditas milik protokol dan terbuka di jendelanya sendiri.
hubCreditLead: Aktifkan, peringkat, dan pekerjaannya: pinjam, bayar, naik level.
hubLoansLead: Pinjam, bayar, naik level. Setiap pembayaran memutar siklus.
hubNetworkLead: Undangan menambah poin reputasi. Saat mereka meminjam dan membayar, Anda mendapat hasil, dan pool dapat mengirim bonus.
hubAdminLead: Hanya 3 dompet pendiri, bukan akun kredit.
txBusy: Operasi sudah berjalan. Tunggu sampai selesai.
appWalletFailed: Pemasangan ini tidak bisa membuka dompetnya. Coba lagi.
errWalletPersist: Tidak bisa menyimpan akun di brankas ponsel ini. Akun Real tidak memakai cadangan lemah.
amountExceedsBalance: Jumlah itu lebih besar dari saldo akun Anda.
poolNeedInternalFunds: Pay from your linked wallet. Funds arrive in this account.
sectionPoolLead: Kotak bersama protokol. Ini bukan akun pribadi Anda: jika Anda menyetor, uang masuk kontrak untuk mendanai pinjaman dan tidak bisa ditarik ke dompet Anda.
poolPublicLead: Pool bukan saldo Anda. Menambah likuiditas mengambil token dari akun Anda dan meninggalkannya di kontrak untuk mendanai pinjaman. Setoran itu tidak bisa ditarik.
poolDestination: NAV pool saat ini: {amount}. Nilai buku itu tetap di kontrak. Administrator tidak menariknya dari aplikasi.
adminLead: Maks 3 pendiri. Dengan ketiga-tiganya di kontrak, setiap perubahan butuh 2 tanda tangan dan 72 jam: satu kunci yang dibobol tidak bisa memindahkan kas atau 15%. Dua lainnya bisa mengganti pemilik, yang menerima 15%, dan menghapus dompet yang terkompromi. Jeda tetap segera (darurat). KYC dan telepon wajib untuk semua dan tidak bisa dimatikan.
protocolPaused: Protokol dijeda. Pinjaman, pendaftaran, dan setoran pool tetap berhenti sampai dilepas (timelock 72 jam).
confirmWithdrawFees: Ini mengirim biaya token dari kontrak ke kolektor. Lanjutkan?
confirmWithdrawBnb: Ini mengirim BNB yang masuk tidak sengaja dari kontrak ke kas. Lanjutkan?
telegramNeedApi: Setel EXPO_PUBLIC_NOTIFY_API untuk menautkan Telegram ke dompet Anda.
pauseProtocolConfirm: Ini segera menghentikan pinjaman, pendaftaran, dan setoran. Melepas jeda butuh usulan, 72 jam, dan konfirmasi.
unpauseProtocolConfirm: Mengusulkan aktivasi ulang. Eksekusi menunggu 72 jam.
securityPausedBanner: Quatrivium Finance dalam jeda darurat. Pinjaman baru, pendaftaran, dan setoran dihentikan. Anda masih bisa membayar utang aktif.
loanLockedBody: Selesaikan pembayaran tepat waktu di level Anda saat ini untuk membuka jumlah ini.
maxLevelNote: Maximum level. It does not rise further. Requests accumulate. Every {count} on-time repayments at this level you may claim the {amount} bonus again.
payOnTimeToBonus: Selesaikan {count} pembayaran tepat waktu di level ini untuk menerima {amount} dari pool
poolBonusPending: Bonus menunggu kas bebas di pool

referralEarnHint: You earn when someone in your network repays credit. Requesting a loan does not pay a commission.
kycLead: KYC is required for credit. Your real name is already tied to this account. Country, city and document stay on this phone. The chain only stores a yes that you declared.
kycDeclare: Saya menyatakan ini mengidentifikasi saya. Saya paham ini bukan pemeriksaan penyedia KYC yang diatur.
kycDone: Pernyataan ditandatangani. Anda masih perlu menautkan telepon untuk mengajukan pinjaman.
kycNeedBeforeLoan: Lengkapi pernyataan identitas sebelum mengajukan pinjaman.

settingsGuideLead: A guide to the rooms you use. Each card says what it does, how you operate it and how you earn. Payments come from the fund when the contract settles them. Internal tools are not described.
guideCreditBody: One loan at a time. Request the amount for your level and repay on the due date. Each on-time payment counts toward the next level. After the due date there is grace; then earnings freeze until you settle.
guideNetworkBody: Your code and link lock in whoever you invite. The sponsor cannot be changed. Commissions settle when someone on your line repays, not when they borrow. There are up to 40 generations. The first Level 1 of a direct referral credits you 1 USDT and does not pay the 15% of that generation.
guideRachaBody: Each day, someone on your network must register, borrow and pay. That day adds to the streak. The buttons claim the ready milestone: 7, 30, 100 or 365 days. If you fall behind, ranking days drop. Streak fame does not.
guideCanjeBody: Fame is claimed only on the path where it was earned. Donating or contributing is exchanged here. Network fame has its own tab. Streak fame is claimed only in Streak. 250 fame = 1 USDT from the fund.
guideBonusesBody: Every 100 levels there is a fund bonus if free cash sits above the floor. Level 100 pays 2,000 USDT. From 200 it is 30,000 USDT every 100 levels through 1000. At 1000, every 100 on-time payments can claim it again.
guideReservaBody: From level 10 you can lock USDT for 30 days, one position at a time. Principal returns. If the pot has funds, an estimated 12% annual cap may apply for that period. This is not a bank deposit.
guideRanksBody: From level 15 you see names, photos and places. Divisions fill 100 at a time. Your seat rises or falls with referrals, repayments, fame, streak, level and bonuses.
guidePoolBody: This is the loan bank. Contributed capital is not withdrawn. It funds loans, exchanges, bonuses and the Reserve extra.
canjeViaRacha: Streak fame: {points}. Claim it in Streak.
guideWalletBody: This is your balance. With a linked wallet you deposit, pay access and move funds. Borrowing and repayment use this same account.
guideIdentityBody: Required on a Real account to open the line. Confirm the code sent to your email and phone, then declare your identity. Demo does not ask for this.
guideDonateBody: A voluntary contribution to the project, separate from access and from the lending fund. On a Real account, with a linked wallet.
guideHistoryBody: Loans, payments, transfers, access, bonuses and donations on this account. Email and phone confirmations do not appear.
referralEarnExamples: If a direct referral repays these levels, you earn:
guideWalletEarn: It does not pay by itself. It is the balance you operate with and where commissions, exchanges and bonuses arrive.
guideIdentityEarn: It does not pay. It only unlocks credit on a Real account.
guideCreditEarn: You do not earn by borrowing. You earn by paying on time: you level up, unlock larger amounts and milestone bonuses become available.
guideNetworkEarn: You earn a share of the interest by distance (15% in generation 1, then 8%, 6%, 4%, 2%, 0.8% and 0.4%). Network fame is redeemed in Exchange, on the network tab.
guideRachaEarn: 100 fame per valid day. Milestones pay 5, 25, 100 or 500 USDT from the fund. That fame is not redeemed in Exchange.
guideCanjeEarn: Converts box or network fame into USDT. Streak fame does not enter this room.
guideBonusesEarn: Level 100: 2,000 USDT. Levels 200 to 1000: 30,000 USDT per milestone. Claim it in Bonuses when the app marks it ready.
guideReservaEarn: The extra on your network commissions (10% from 50 USDT locked, 20% from 500) is paid from the lending fund. The estimated 12%, if any, comes from the Reserve pot.
guideDonateEarn: Adds box fame: 100 fame per 1 USDT. Redeem it in Exchange, on the donate or contribute tab.
guideRanksEarn: If there is a monthly prize, it is estimated from 1.5% of free cash. Anyone in arrears does not receive it. The unassigned share stays in the fund.
guideHistoryEarn: It does not pay. It lets you review what already happened on your account.
guidePoolEarn: Contributing adds box fame (100 per USDT), redeemed in Exchange. The capital stays in the fund.
